name: Hat ko nia
summary: Hạt kơ nia is an almond-sized nut with a thin brown shell. Peel it for the white kernel, which is rich, fragrant, and sweet and nutty.
origin: Mang Den weekend market, where hạt kơ nia is sold as a Central Highlands specialty.
texture: About the size of an almond, with a thin brown shell and a white kernel.
taste: Rich and fragrant, with a sweet, nutty finish: béo ngậy, thơm, and ngọt bùi in Vietnamese.
howToEat: Peel the thin brown shell and eat the white kernel. The market list also spells it hạt cờ nia.
where: Chợ phiên Măng Đen, the weekend market, meets on Saturday and Sunday on the pine hill along Hùng Vương. Báo Kon Tum also places it in the pine garden (Vườn thông) by the district central square.
seoTitle: Hat ko nia in Mang Den
seoDescription: Hạt kơ nia, an almond-sized highland nut with a rich, fragrant, sweet and nutty kernel, at the Mang Den weekend market.
